messages:
zoe: Kicking off the Earlybird pricing experiment canary at 09:00 PT for ~5% of PAYG accounts. Need finance + billing ops validation on invoice templates and grandfathering rules before we flip more. Ping @emma for sign-off and @pradeep for metering/recon checks. runbook: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/pricing/earlybird

pradeep: Seen. Quick q — are we applying the new tier thresholds immediately for canary accounts or preserving old thresholds for grandfathered subs?

ashley: We'll preserve thresholds for any subscription with legacy_grandfathered = true. Template needs a flag to show preserved pricing line on invoices. I'll swap template token once canary starts and share sample.

mike: SQL I used to pull the canary cohort invoices for a sanity check:
```sql
SELECT account_id, sum(tokens) AS tokens, applied_rate
FROM billing.usage
WHERE experiment = 'earlybird' AND ts >= '2026-03-23'
GROUP BY account_id, applied_rate;
```

billing-bot: Canary deploy initiated at 2026-03-23T16:00:00Z · cohort=5% · job_id=canary-20260323-17 · status=started :rocket:

emma: I can approve grandfathering wording. Please add footer text: "Legacy pricing preserved per subscription agreement" and include a grandfathering flag in the invoice JSON payload. I will sign off once I see the sample invoice. :white_check_mark:

sara: PR opened to patch invoice template: https://github.com/redwood/billing/pull/1243 — adds footer + invoice_metadata.grandfathered boolean. Deploy to staging for canary sample.

pradeep: Ran quick reconciliation on staging for acct 789 — usage & applied_rate look good. One minor tax rounding diff of $0.03 on line item 2. Investigating rounding rules between invoice generator and tax service.

zoe: Good catch. If that rounding issue propagates we should pause the canary. Keep me posted in this thread, please.

mike: Watching metrics. Dashboard for canary cohort: https://observability.redwood/boards/earlybird (latency/cost/normalized-price). Alert if invoice error rate > 0.5% or revenue delta > 2%.

ashley: Sample invoice attached in staging (link in PR comments). Looks like grandfathering footer shows correctly. Tax rounding source: different decimal precision in generator vs tax service. Fixing to consistent 4 decimal internal calc before final round.

pradeep: OK tested fix locally, rounding aligned now. Will run another batch later and post sample.

emma: Approved for expanded canary to 20% once the next batch validates. Holding final enterprise-wide rollout until accounting signs off after end-of-day reconciliation.

zoe: Thanks. Action items: 1) sara/ashley merge template PR and deploy to staging, 2) pradeep run full recon and post sample invoices, 3) emma sign-off for 20% expansion. If all green we roll tomorrow morning. :eyes:

emma: ACK — will review recon samples when posted.

billing-bot: Canary cohort update at 2026-03-23T16:14:00Z · cohort=5% · invoices_generated=47 · errors=0 · job_id=canary-20260323-17

zoe: Awesome. Thanks team — keep updates here.

emma: Done reviewing samples. thumbs up from finance. :thumbsup:
